name: Step by Little Step
source:
Bring your cat back to the world of the living.

The rules are simple, as they are familiar:

Do not look back.
and everything will be just the way it was before.

[From [url=https://summerorigins.itch.io/step-by-little-step]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
把你的猫带回生者的世界。

规则很简单，因为它们很熟悉：

不要回头。
一切都会像以前一样。

[来自[url=https://summerorigins.itch.io/step-by-little-step]itch.io[/url]]
